verdict.still_air: FAIL at hover and peak - not acceptable at any sustained power
verdict.propwash_hover: PASS in slipstream (103.2 C); FAILS at the disc (128.9 C)
verdict.propwash_peak: FAILS the 125 C target at both airflows: 132.7 C slipstream, 169.9 C at the disc
verdict.summary: MARGINAL. Sustained peak is not acceptable at either airflow. Acceptability depends entirely on peak duration and duty cycle, which are OPEN. At h=60 duty cycles up to 0.5 remain under the 125 C target.

h_superseded.reason: requires 22.4 m/s; aircraft slipstream is 12.46 m/s

remediation.note: Rth(j-c) + R_spread contribute only 5.7 K of the rise. More copper and more thermal vias cannot fix the peak case; the bottleneck is board-to-air, not die-to-board.

thermal.absolute_max_is_not_a_target: Tj = 175 C is the absolute maximum, not an operating target

primary_remaining_variables.first: airflow exposure / placement relative to the rotor disc
primary_remaining_variables.not_primary: copper area, thermal via count and Rds(on) -- Rth(j-c) plus spreading account for only 5.7 K of the rise, so these cannot fix the sustained peak case

system_requirements.engineering_statement: Peak thermal acceptability cannot be determined from peak current alone. Peak duration and repetition rate determine whether the 115 A condition is a transient event or a thermally significant operating condition.

freeze.unfreeze_policy: Unfreezing is a deliberate, reviewed act. It requires at minimum that peak_duration_ms and peak_duty_cycle be supplied, the airflow boundary condition be specified, and the thermal validation plan be executed. Do not unfreeze to make progress.
